title: andrographis macrobotrys var. ceylanica
intro: Andrographis macrobotrys var. ceylanica, commonly known as Kalmegh or Kalamegin, is a plant species belonging to the family Acanthaceae. The health benefits of Kalmegh include its potential to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of fever, as well as its role in supporting the immune system and fighting off infections. The therapeutic actions of Kalmegh are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Kalmegh include flavonoids, alkaloids, and lignans, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
